missing_atoms: reject any native/control pair with incomplete canonical heavy atoms in the union of their interface nodes; do not impute
donors: same frozen fold, same domain, exact observed MHC and B2M sequences, equal peptide length, different peptide sequence
transformation: single proper Kabsch rotation+translation of ALL donor peptide atoms onto receiver N/CA/C/O backbone; no local stitching or coordinate minimization
steric_policy_note: deliberately conservative heavy-atom-only screen, including N/O contacts; may exclude legitimate tight hydrogen bonds; not MolProbity clashscore
pin_nodes: same union of native and transfer interface residue keys; completeness required in both
pairing: one native and one control per retained receiver; no unmatched positives in training arrays
tuning: fixed before reconstruction; no training/AUROC based threshold selection
